paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan ben Beteira: the elders of the House of Shammai and House of Hillel went up to his upper chamber: Menachot 41b, end. Zevachim 63a has ‘Rabbi Yochanan ben Beteira said’; but in that very matter in Menachot 8b, end, the reading is ‘Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira.’ See Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira, and examine which is fitting [ותרבה איזה יוכשר; rendering provisional]. In Sifrei, Shelach: ‘Rabbi Yonatan ben Beteira,’ to whose upper chamber the elders of the House of Shammai and House of Hillel went up. One is a scribal error.
